title: Fate's Twin
next_chapter_hook: "Just as the Demonic Path commander was about to vanish, he left behind those profound words—'Beyond the chess game lies an even greater game.' Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record Fragment, a unprecedented chill spreading through his heart. He realized that what he faced might never have been a chess game at all, but merely dust in a much grander scheme."

text.content: "Ling Yuan's presence bore down like a collapsing mountain, yet Chen Ji remained motionless. He sat cross-legged at the edge of the Cliff overlooking the Dragon's Vein depths, surrounded by a mingling of sulfur and decay—that unique scent of the earth's depths. The blood-red characters on the fourth page of the Tianji Record burned fiercely, making his Brow Center throb, as if an invisible eye was peering through those words to observe him. 'No. 49...' he murmured, repeating the words, a mocking arc curving at the corner of his lips, 'So I was already meat on the chopping block long ago.'"

"At that moment, space tore apart abruptly. A pitch-black crack burst open three zhang beside Chen Ji, as if something was forcing its way through from the Void's crevice. Chen Ji's pupils contracted, his right hand already subtly resting on the rusty short blade at his waist—the only self-defense weapon he'd never abandoned throughout his servant years. A low laugh echoed from the crack, as grating as metal scraping, yet it ceased abruptly the next instant."

"A hand, pale to the point of translucence, reached out from the crack, grasping the edge of the spatial fissure. That hand was identical to Chen Ji's, even the old scar on the tiger's mouth from childhood was flawless. Chen Ji's breath caught for a moment—he already guessed what was about to appear. A figure stepped slowly out from the crack, a玄black robe billowing in the wind, features mirror-symmetrical to Chen Ji's, except for those eyes—burning with dark red flames deep within the pupils, forming a bizarre contrast with the Heavenly Secrets Divine Light in Chen Ji's eyes."

dialogue.content: "'No. 49, long time no see.' That voice was identical to Chen Ji's, yet carried an inexplicable hoarseness, 'Or should I call you... the other me?'"

text.content: "Chen Ji rose slowly, his face wearing the habitual timid expression he'd performed for seven full years in the Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters. However, his left hand hanging at his side curled slightly, his knuckles white from tension—this was his true reaction, only revealed when alone. 'Demonic Path commander?' he ventured timidly, his voice trembling slightly, 'Elder must have mistaken me for someone else. I'm merely a floor-sweeper at the Tianqing Sect...'"

dialogue.content: "'Enough.' The Demonic Path commander raised his hand to cut him off, a playful smile appearing on that pallid face, 'This trick works on that Su Qingyao girl, but performing it before me?' He stepped forward, the aura beneath his black robe surging like an abyss, 'Both of us know the Tianji Record never mistakes its target—it chose two.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's 'timid' expression froze for a moment. He hadn't expected the other to so directly pierce through that layer of window paper. But this was within his expectations—the fated twins, the Tianji Record split in two, one choosing him, the other choosing this 'self' who had stirred up blood and wind across the Demonic Path. 'So what?' he干脆卸下disguised, his voice line turning cold, 'Twins killing each other—isn't this the favorite entertainment of Heavenly Dao?'"

"The Demonic Path commander actually laughed at these words, that laughter echoing through the vast Dragon's Vein depths, startling a swarm of dark insects. 'Kill each other?' He shook his head, unfastening his collar to reveal a ferocious scar on his chest—that scar presented a bizarre chessboard pattern, as if someone had carved a complete chessboard onto his chest with a sharp blade. 'This is the mark fate's chess game has branded on us. Did you think we had the right to choose to kill or not to kill?'"

"Chen Ji's gaze fell upon that chessboard scar, an indescribable chill surging in his heart. He remembered the blurry prophetic visions on the Tianji Record Fragment—the chessboard, the heaven's center, the black and white twins. Back then he thought those were merely metaphors, but now it seemed they were unmistakably the true portrayal of their fate. He spoke slowly: 'What are the rules?'"

dialogue.content: "'The rules are simple.' The Demonic Path commander fastened his collar, an complex light flickering in his eyes, 'Only one twin can survive to leave the chess game. Either you kill me, or I kill you, or...' he paused, 'we cooperate to break this chess game.'"

choice.prompt: "Faced with the rule that only one of the fated twins could survive, Chen Ji had to make a choice—to accept this absurd rule, or to challenge it?"

choices.description: "'Break the chess game? You think I haven't considered that? Heavenly Dao set this rule, so it must have backup plans. Rather than risk cooperation, I'd better first understand its bottom cards.'"
choices.visible_reward: Gaining More Information About the Chess Game Rules
choices.risk_hint: Possibly Angering the Other Party, Missing Cooperation Opportunity

text.content: "The Demonic Path commander's brow arched slightly, clearly not expecting him to so directly question the chess game itself. But he quickly recovered that nonchalant expression, 'Brave. You're right—Heavenly Dao never leaves loopholes, it leaves a bigger chessboard.'"

choices.description: "'Breaking the chess game, sharing the final reward? That's an tempting offer. But I need to know how many secrets you're still hiding from me.'"
choices.visible_cost: Entangling with the Demonic Path Forces
choices.visible_reward: Gaining a Powerful Ally, Reducing Future Combat Risks
choices.risk_hint: The Other Party May Harbor Ill Intentions
choices.process_label: agree to cooperate, demand intel sharing

text.content: "A flicker of appreciation crossed the Demonic Path commander's eyes as he stepped forward, closing the distance between them to within a few meters. 'Straightforward. I knew I wasn't wrong about you—we are the same person, we just took different paths.'"

choices.description: "'Cooperate? Heavenly Dao is watching. Do you think it would allow us to exploit rule loopholes? What a joke. Rather than trust you, I'd better trust that I can fight my way through.'"
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining Independence, Uncontrolled by the Other Party
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander's Strength Is Profound and Unfathomable
choices.process_label: flatly refuse, hint at solo breakthrough

text.content: "The Demonic Path commander's expression darkened, the demonic energy around him churning like a tide. But he quickly restrained his anger, instead revealing a meaningful smile, 'Brave spirit. But consider this carefully—refusing cooperation means you choose to face all of Heavenly Dao's malice alone.'"

"Chen Ji did not answer immediately. Instead, he raised his eyes to stare directly into those burning dark red flames. He was observing, examining every possible flaw in the other. Suddenly, he noticed an extremely faint pattern on the side of the Demonic Path commander's neck—that pattern presented an eyeball shape, identical to the 'Eye of Heavenly Dao' symbol on the Tianji Record. His pupils contracted sharply, a terrible speculation surfacing in his mind."

dialogue.content: "'What are you looking at?' The Demonic Path commander sensed his unusual gaze and下意识touched the side of his neck."

text.content: "Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, but that momentary abnormality had already been caught by the other. The air was filled with subtle tension, two identical-looking men confronting each other across three chi, as if conducting an unspoken contest. Eventually, it was the Demonic Path commander who broke the silence first: 'It seems you've discovered it.' His tone lowered, 'Yes, the Eye of Heavenly Dao implanted something in me—or rather, it saw something in me.'"

"Chen Ji's heart missed a beat. The Eye of Heavenly Dao had planted surveillance in the Demonic Path commander? What did that mean? Did it mean this 'twin' was from the beginning a chess piece arranged by Heavenly Dao, or... 'You know you're being monitored?' he asked. The Demonic Path commander let out a bitter laugh, 'From the moment I gained consciousness, it's been speaking in my head. Telling me what to do, what not to do. It's controlled me like a puppet for three hundred full years.'"

"Three hundred years. Chen Ji was horrified inside. This number far exceeded his imagination—he thought his three years after being chosen by the Tianji Record had been difficult enough, but this person had actually been controlled by the Eye of Heavenly Dao for an even longer time. This meant the pain and struggle the other had endured was far deeper than it appeared. But it also meant... 'So your coming to me isn't just about breaking the chess game.' Chen Ji spoke slowly, 'You want to use my hand to free yourself from the Eye of Heavenly Dao's control.'"

dialogue.content: "'Smart.' The Demonic Path commander nodded without evasion, 'The Tianji Record is one of the chess pieces Heavenly Dao has placed in this world, but it's also the only thing that can interfere with the Eye of Heavenly Dao's perception. You and I are two sides of the same coin, one yin one yang—only together can we tear open a gap right under that thing's nose.'"

choice.prompt: "The Demonic Path commander revealed the secret of being controlled by the Eye of Heavenly Dao for three hundred years and proposed joining forces against Heavenly Dao. What choice should Chen Ji make?"

choices.description: "'Cooperation is possible, but I have conditions: all actions must be approved by me, and you must disclose all intelligence about the Eye of Heavenly Dao that you possess.'"
choices.visible_cost: Needing to Share Partial Intelligence with the Demonic Path Forces
choices.visible_reward: Gaining Important Intelligence About the Eye of Heavenly Dao, Reducing Monitoring Risks
choices.risk_hint: The Other Party May Hide Key Information

text.content: "The Demonic Path commander pondered silently for a moment, then finally nodded: 'Deal. But I have one condition too—before I confirm you're trustworthy, we maintain a distance of three zhang, and neither of us discloses today's events to anyone.'"

choices.text: Requiring the Other Party to First Prove Sincerity
choices.description: "'A three-hundred-year controller wants to rebel? You think I'd believe that? Show some sincerity first—like telling me how to shield against the Eye of Heavenly Dao's perception.'"
choices.visible_cost: Negotiation Time Extends, Potentially Missing the Opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Gaining the Method to Shield the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: May Be Seen as Distrust, Escalating Conflicts
choices.process_label: demand proof of sincerity, get shielding method

text.content: "The Demonic Path commander's expression shifted slightly, clearly hit in a tender spot. But after a moment he took a deep breath, 'Fine, I'll tell you—Demonic Path mist can briefly conceal the Tianji Record's aura. This is my sincerity.'"

choices.description: "'I understand your situation, but the alliance is too significant a matter. I need time to consider. Three days later, same place, we can discuss again.'"
choices.visible_cost: Many Variables May Arise Within Three Days
choices.visible_reward: Gaining Time to Lay Plans, Seizing Initiative
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander May Take Other Actions in the Meantime

text.content: "A flicker of disappointment crossed the Demonic Path commander's eyes, but it was quickly replaced by understanding. 'Very well. The three-day deadline, I'll wait for you.' He turned toward the spatial crack, his black robe fluttering in the wind."

"Just as the Demonic Path commander was about to step into the crack, he suddenly halted and turned his head. The dark red flames danced in those eyes, reflecting some indescribably complex emotions. 'Chen Ji, there's something I must warn you about.' His voice was low, 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao never gazes upon just one chess piece—that Su family girl's been under its gaze without a moment's rest.'"

"Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his knuckles cracking from tension. Su Qingyao—that Inner Disciple Senior Fellow who repeatedly approached the truth, that person he had been deliberately avoiding. 'What do you mean?' His voice was extremely low, carrying a hint of urgency he himself hadn't noticed. The Demonic Path commander glanced back at him, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of his lips: 'She has the second mark. I can see it, but you can't—because you care too much about her.'"

"This sentence was like a basin of cold water poured over his head. Chen Ji stood in place, gazing at that gradually narrowing spatial crack, his heart churning with indescribable emotions. Three hundred years of control, a three-day deadline, the mark on Su Qingyao—all this information interwove rapidly in his mind, piecing together a chilling picture. The Eye of Heavenly Dao wasn't just monitoring them—it was arranging a scheme, weaving an impenetrable net using everyone."

dialogue.content: "At the final instant before the spatial crack closed completely, the Demonic Path commander's voice drifted from the Void, carrying an unfathomable nuance: 'Beyond the chess game lies an even greater game. Remember this—when you think you've seen through the truth, that's when true danger begins.'"

text.content: "The crack closed completely, and the Dragon's Vein depths returned to dead silence. Chen Ji stood alone at the Cliff Edge, the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand emanating a faint glow. He raised his head toward the thin thread of daylight above the abyss, those words echoing repeatedly in his mind. Beyond the chess game lies an even greater game. What did this mean? Did it mean that they, these so-called 'chess pieces,' had all along been merely dust on an even larger chessboard? Did it mean that above the Eye of Heavenly Dao there existed something even higher? A chill spread from his spine, and for the first time Chen Ji felt a true sense of powerlessness. But soon, the confusion in his eyes was replaced by icy light—the more desperate the predicament, the more one needed calm calculation. He slowly unfolded the Tianji Record Fragment, the blood-red characters 'No. 49 Has Been Marked by Heavenly Dao' on the fourth page still shocking to the eye. Chen Ji stared at that line, then suddenly laughed lightly: 'Marked? Fine, then let Heaven see how a marked chess piece overturns the entire game.' He put away the Fragment and turned, stepping into the darkness. The three-day deadline—he still had much to do."
